lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa and George are playing hide and seek.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在玩捉迷藏。

lines.en: It is George's turn to hide. He must quickly find somewhere to hide before Peppa finishes counting.
lines.zh: 轮到乔治躲起来了。他必须在佩奇数完之前赶快找个地方躲好。

lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. George has found somewhere to hide.
lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八。乔治找到了躲藏的地方。

lines.en: Just in time! Ready or not, here I come!
lines.zh: 正好赶上！不管准备好了没有，我来了！

lines.en: Peppa has to find where George is hiding.
lines.zh: 佩奇要找出乔治躲在哪里。

lines.en: Found you! Peppa has found George.
lines.zh: 找到你啦！佩奇找到了乔治。

lines.en: George, I could see you too easily. Now it is Peppa's turn to hide.
lines.zh: 乔治，我太容易就看到你了。现在轮到佩奇躲起来了。

lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Okay, George, open your eyes!
lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。好了，乔治，睁开眼睛吧！

lines.en: George has to find where Peppa is hiding.
lines.zh: 乔治要找出佩奇躲在哪里。

lines.en: Peppa isn't hiding under the table.
lines.zh: 佩奇没有躲在桌子下面。

lines.en: George, have you thought of looking upstairs?
lines.zh: 乔治，你有没有想过上楼去看看？

lines.en: Peppa isn't under the bed.
lines.zh: 佩奇不在床底下。

lines.en: What was that strange noise?
lines.zh: 那是什么奇怪的声音？

lines.en: Peppa isn't behind the curtain.
lines.zh: 佩奇不在窗帘后面。

lines.en: There is that strange noise again. What can it be?
lines.zh: 那个奇怪的声音又出现了。会是什么呢？

lines.en: George found me! Now it's Daddy's turn to hide.
lines.zh: 乔治找到我了！现在轮到爸爸躲起来了。

lines.en: George should have another turn, but George isn't very good at hiding.
lines.zh: 乔治应该再玩一次，但乔治不太会躲。

lines.en: I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
lines.zh: 我肯定他这次会好一点。闭上眼睛开始数数吧。

lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Ready or not, here I come!
lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。不管准备好了没有，我来了！

lines.en: Oh, George is hiding under the table.
lines.zh: 哦，乔治躲在桌子下面。

lines.en: But George always hides under the table. Have you thought of looking upstairs?
lines.zh: 可是乔治总是躲在桌子下面。你有没有想过上楼去看看？

lines.en: I know where he is.
lines.zh: 我知道他在哪里。

lines.en: George is in the toy basket.
lines.zh: 乔治在玩具筐里。

lines.en: Oh, George is not in the toy basket.
lines.zh: 哦，乔治不在玩具筐里。

lines.en: Where can he be?
lines.zh: 他会在哪里呢？

lines.en: Peppa cannot find George anywhere. Daddy, I can't find George anywhere!
lines.zh: 佩奇到处都找不到乔治。爸爸，我哪儿都找不到乔治！

lines.en: Oh dear, I wonder where he can be.
lines.zh: 哎呀，我真想知道他会在哪里。

lines.en: Actually, I think there's something about George in this newspaper.
lines.zh: 其实，我觉着这张报纸上有点乔治的线索。

lines.en: George found you!
lines.zh: 乔治找到你了！

lines.en: Oh, George, that was a good place to hide.
lines.zh: 哦，乔治，那真是个躲藏的好地方。

lines.en: George was hiding behind Daddy Pig's newspaper all the time.
lines.zh: 乔治一直躲在猪爸爸的报纸后面。
